data.command: Tell me about your network configuration

data.text:
My network configuration is a bit of a mess, if I'm being honest! *laughs* We're running a fairly standard setup, but I've made some modifications here and there to suit our needs. We're using the 192.168.1.0/24 subnet, and our router is configured to use the 10.0.0.0/24 range for the internet-facing interface. Don't mind the scribbles on the wall – I've got a few notes up on the wall about the config from a while back... *points*

We're running a handful of services on the internal network, including a few virtual machines (VMs) for testing and development. I've got a couple of them set up on the 10.0.0.1/24 subnet, and we've got a separate VLAN for our guest network on 10.0.0.10/24. I've also set up a few iptables rules to filter traffic and block some unnecessary packets.

If you want a peek at the actual config files, I can show you the `/etc/network/interfaces` file we use to manage the network settings. We've got a few custom scripts in `/etc/network/` that handle some of the more... interesting
